title: Nick Chubb Announces NFL Retirement After 8 Seasons

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Nick Chubb Announces NFL Retirement After 8 Seasons
sources.description: This evening I a heartfelt social media posting former Bulldog great Nick Chubb announced his retirement after eight NFL seasons. The Ground Hound from Cedartown was of course one of the defining players of the Kirby Smart era at Georgia, helping lead the Bulldogs to their first national title game appearance in over 30 years […]
